audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Vayne Levels 1, 2, 3, 6 and 2+ items, and rated the lane 8.5/10 difficulty, in a 57.06% matchup over 333 games.
audit.why: The packet chart, the content whys and the mid-game prose all describe Heimerdinger owning Levels 2 through 6 with the nest; only 2+ items is Vayne's.
audit.corrected: Sides set to Skill / Heimerdinger x5 / Vayne, ratings rebalanced, and difficulty moved to 5.5/10.

audit.why: spikes cover Lvl 1 (her contest window), Lvl 4-5 nest, Level 6 UPGRADE!!!, and 2-item Silver Bolts / Final Hour.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing named Tumble as an auto-attack reset, so the page told you to react to the cast rather than the wind-up.
audit.why: Tumble's kit flag is autoReset: her damage arrives on the attack that follows the tumble, which is the actual tell.
audit.corrected: Key Ability Interactions now names the Tumble auto-reset and the wall rule for Condemn.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn was tracked with no number attached.
audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s — the longest punishable window in her kit and the whole basis of the commit rule.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers added to the Do and to the Levels 4-5 stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Trading lines referred to Vayne as 'he' throughout.
audit.why: Wrong pronoun on a named champion reads as boilerplate and undercuts trust in the rest of the page.
audit.corrected: Trading text rewritten in her pronouns and keyed to the tumble rather than a generic step-up.

edits.before: One turret + AA wins level 1 against almost everyone. Identify how Vayne contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: One turret and no grenade yet — Vayne's Tumble (Q) weaves an auto in and back out of your rockets. This is her one stage.

edits.before: Three turrets make your half of lane a no-entry zone. Only take the trade when Vayne's Condemn is down.
edits.after: A second turret and its slowing beams tax every last-hit her Tumble tries to grab, and she cannot trade it back.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Vayne must walk into your range.
edits.after: Three banked turret charges turn the choke into a beam wall her Tumble cannot cross without eating damage going in.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Condemn's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: A full nest plus the CH-3X center-stun makes a tumble-in suicidal — she is zoned off CS, and Condemn is down 14-20s.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Vayne's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: UPGRADE!!! into a super-turret or a wider grenade peaks your siege — she cannot melt three buildings before the stun lands.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Condemn's cooldown.
edits.after: Liandry's and your turret economy out-pace her first item — take tower while Silver Bolts is weak.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Vayne carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Silver Bolts true damage chews your turrets and Final Hour stealth kites the immobile nest — she reclaims the game.

edits.before: Track Vayne's Condemn: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. When it is down — E-stun + turret her.
edits.after: Her combo opens on a Tumble auto-reset — back off on the wind-up, not the cast. Avoid walls.

edits.before: Wall-stun. Don’t get pinned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Wall-stun, down 14-20s. Commit only once it is baited or spent.

edits.before: Keep Vayne farming inside turret range, W-poke his step-ups, and E-stun the moment he commits into the nest.
edits.after: Keep Vayne farming outside the nest, W-poke her step-ups, and E-stun the moment she tumbles into the beams.

edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5.5/10. You win lane on the nest; the risk is Condemn pinning you against a wall.
